note: Drops the os.environ fallback for the Anthropic API key and relies solely on settings.anthropic_api_key; removes the os import.
Moves the team api_token lookup out of activity entry to just before the post-store emit; the existing-summary branch no longer emits or fetches the token.
Only changes type annotations from TracerProvider to trace.TracerProvider; the per-instrumentor try/except logging boilerplate is untouched.
README renames tables to sourcebatch/sourcebatchstatus and the view to v_latest_source_batch_status, noting they live in a new dedicated DB.
Replaces direct posthog.capture in the FAB with a new reportWizardSyncProgressExpanded action on eventUsageLogic.
Replaces the inline node-type computation with a shared node_type_for helper imported from saved_query_dag_sync.
Adds _patch_organization_usage_jsonb helper using Organization.objects.filter().update(usage=RawSQL(...)); both raw-cursor call sites now use it.
Introduces a single HogGlobalDefinition array with per-target descriptions that drives both the Monaco globals and the rendered help dl.
Deletes the custom SlopeGraphLegend and enables the quill SlopeChart built-in legend gated on the Show legend toggle.
Only switches the rollout bucket hash to Math.imul and adds a test; routing logic is not consolidated with the dual-write output.
Passes dateFilter into ensureSessionTitleLoaded inside the existing useEffect; the useEffect remains.
Splits the common tool list into named overview and followup lists and composes them without index slicing.
Widens ticket ownership checks to all distinct IDs of the verified person; the HMAC secret source is unchanged.
Replaces the manual api.create batch_check call with the generated llmAnalyticsSummarizationBatchCheckCreate client.
Removes abort-warning emission from the v0 endpoint and moves it into events/analytics.rs alongside v1 handling, extending ingestion_warnings.
Test now imports run_hog_eval from run_evaluation, matching the path used by the MCP tool.
Replaces schedule_hour/schedule_minute with a cron_expression CharField in the migration, with service and serializer updates.
Removes the saved-insight picker parameter from buildInsertCommands in favour of a generic extraCommands list; the app-specific command moves to the renderer.
Drops stored last_run_at/last_run_status fields; they become properties derived from last_task_run.
Sets evaluation_target on the content dataclass (new schema field) and serializes via to_dict instead of adding a raw dict key.
